svg.title: A murmuration port: connectivity, islands and the falcon's wave
svg.desc: Side view, connectivity and polarisation, k-NN islands and the agitation wave of a stdlib port of the murmuration prototype at 1875 birds.
svg.text: Murmuration brief constants, simulated: 1875 birds, 7 topological neighbours
c closed islands: 12 clumps of 8 birds
d agitation wave after the falcon arrives
blue: percent of the flock above 0.35; orange: farthest such bird from the falcon (world units)
